name: Mahou Shoujo ☆ Dai Shippai
source:
This is the Magical Girl Raising Lab!
Choose your favorite girl and attributes and make a magical girl!
But... what? Somehow something is wrong...?

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6566]NovelGame[/url]]

這裡是魔法少女養成實驗室！
挑選喜歡的女孩與屬性，創造一位魔法少女吧！
可是……咦？怎麼總覺得哪裡不太對勁……？
